intro: Guyana has about 800,000 people of Indian, African, Indigenous, Chinese and European descent.

chapters.title: People
text: Indo-Guyanese are the largest group, followed by Afro-Guyanese. English is official, and Guyanese Creole is widely spoken. Hinduism, Christianity and Islam are all practised.

chapters.title: Georgetown
text: Georgetown, the capital, has wooden colonial buildings, including St George's Cathedral.
